Title: Users may be unable to access multiple Microsoft 365 services using Global Secure Access (GSA)
Message:
User impact: Users may be unable to access multiple Microsoft 365 services using GSA.
 
More info: Impacted services may include, but aren't limited to:
- Outlook
- Outlook on the web
- OneDrive
- SharePoint Online
- Microsoft Teams
- Windows 365 Cloud PCs

Current status: We've completed redirecting traffic to healthy infrastructure and are assessing for positive trends towards recovery. We're continuing to investigate additional mitigating actions to expedite remediation.

Start time: Tuesday, October 13, 2026, at 8:00 AM UTC

Next update by: Tuesday, October 13, 2026, at 4:30 PM UTC
